blurb: Captain Joe's Fishing offers guided fishing experiences on Lake Harmony in the Pocono Mountains. They provide walk/wade fly fishing for trout, fishing from a custom poling skiff, and custom packages tailored to the guest. The service caters to all anglers from beginners to seasoned fly fishing veterans.
